Nextstrain is a powerful platform for building, hosting, and interacting with phylogenies. The [Pekosz Lab](https://pekoszlab.com/) leverages this platform to facilitate discussions sorrounding emerging Influenza A and B variants during genomic surveillance each influenza season.  

Pekosz lab Nextstrain Builds are freely hosted by the Nextstrain team at the following locations: 
- A private website for internal surveillance meetings: https://nextstrain.org/groups/PekoszLab (contact apekosz1@jh.edu for access)
- A publically hosted website for publications: https://nextstrain.org/groups/PekoszLab-Public

::: {.callout-note} 

This tutorial is optimized to run on machines running MacOS. Users who desire to run this pipeline on Windows must refer to the [WSL installation documentation](https://docs.nextstrain.org/en/latest/install.html) provided by Nextstrain. 

::: 

- [Tutorial Slides](slides/v2_nextstrain_tutorial.html)

- If you would prefer to read the tutorial, a version has been written to supplement parallel execution of the builds. [Click here](tutorial.qmd) for a reading friendly version.

- All code necessary to run both this tutorial and the pipline with "real world" data from the Mostafa lab can be found at [https://github.com/Pekosz-Lab/nextstrain/tree/main](https://github.com/Pekosz-Lab/nextstrain/tree/main)
